description: Prefill the Bar Chart Race Maker: an animated bar chart from a table or CSV, where bars grow, shrink and overtake each other. Returns a link that opens the Tool with these options; the user presses Export there to download the video. All options are optional. Icons, images and audio that need a file upload are not supported. Here the look, timing, text and built-in step sounds work, on sample data. The data table (typed, pasted, or from CSV or Excel), logos on bars, per-step seconds, your own step sound and music are added on the Tool's page: open the link and add or upload them there (they stay in the browser).

abbr.description: Whether large values are shortened to K, M, B or T, as 1.2M. Default: false.

axis.description: Whether a value axis with gridlines is drawn. Default: false.

bars.description: How many bars are shown at once. Default: 8.

cx.description: How far the bars move right, in percent of the frame width. Default: 0.

cy.description: How far the bars move down, in percent of the frame height. Default: 0.

dec.description: Decimal places shown in the values. Default: "0".

dur.description: Total seconds of the race. Default: 10.

ease.description: How values and bars move from one step to the next. Default: "ease-in-out".

end.description: Seconds the final frame holds at the end. Default: 1.

fill.description: Whether bars are one solid color or a gradient of it. Default: "solid".

font.description: Font id of the chart text. Default: "inter".

hl.description: Name of one item to highlight while the others are dimmed. It must match a name in the table. Default: "".

hold.description: Seconds each step of the race holds before the next. Default: 0.

max.description: A fixed value that fills the width; bars over it stay full width. 0 scales to the current leader. Default: 0.

names.description: Where item names go: beside the bars (above them in 9:16), above the bars, or inside them. Default: "side".

order.description: Bar order from the top: largest value first, smallest first, or the order of the table rows. Default: "largest".

pal.description: Color palette of the bars. Default: "vivid".

pre.description: Text before each value, such as $. Default: "".

ranks.description: Whether each bar shows its current rank number. Default: false.

salign.description: Alignment of the step label. Default: "right".

sep.description: Thousands separator of the values. Default: "comma".

shape.description: Corners of the bars: slightly rounded, square, or fully rounded. Default: "soft".

splace.description: Whether the step label sits above (up) or below (down) the chart. Default: "down".

src.description: Source credit line at the bottom of the frame, such as 'Source: World Bank'. Default: "".

sub.description: Second line under the title. Default: "".

suf.description: Text after each value, such as %. Default: "".

tick.description: Sound played each time the step label changes; "off" for silence. Default: "off".

title.description: Chart title text. Default: "Most used video editors".

name: create_bar_chart_race
title: Bar Chart Race Maker
